_about: Curated anthroposophical YouTube channels for Sophia Commons. Edit this file to add a channel: give it a slug, name, url (youtube.com/@handle, /channel/UC..., or /c/...), language, category. channel_id may be null; the weekly sync resolves it from the page. The sync upserts this list into Supabase (public.youtube_channels) every week.
